content.text: Autoimmune dx leading to blister form & severe pruritis –
Type II hypersensitivity rxn – IgG autoantibodies against hemidesmosomes & basement membrane zone causing
Tense lrg bullae that don’t rupture as easily
MC involving the groin, axilla, trunk, & flexural surfaces
Skin bx w/ direct immunofluorescence gold strd
: linear C3 & IgG along the dermal-epidermal junction,
first line for mild dz or applied to early lesions to prevent blisters
▪︎Loss of cell to cell adhesion in epidermis
, perianal, groin, inframammary regions, & apocrine gland-rich areas
followed by follicular rupture & an assoc inflam rxn
, hx of acne, family hx, mech friction, meds
Deep-seated inflam nodules & abscesses, draining tracts, & fibrotic hypertrophic scars
: dietary chgs (⍉↑glycemic foods), smoke cessation, local skin care, eliminate irritants
if sm, unroofing of lrger ones w/ washout
▪︎rare d/o w/ recurr oral + genital ulcerations, eye lesions, skin lesions, + ⊕pathergy test
